_why: expressjs/express: req.fresh now also validates QUERY requests (a one-line condition) plus two tests and a changelog line. Nothing to deploy — a good map invents no ops, and a one-condition change needs at most one diagram.

mentions.why: the effect: a QUERY can now get 304 Not Modified
